notes: histories are independent seeds derived from --seed; the donor life for yoked is streamSeed(history seed, donor).
cross share applies to queried facts (only queried facts are cross or own).
temporal writes top two bids at half retention; gain alternates by tick parity; gain writes replace the primary, non-gain writes are alternatives.
local_only banks budget per tick (carried over) and spends one unit per other faculty asked, in fixed order.
oracle writes the arrival whose current value is queried soonest, on the single-write channel.
capability loss halves the memory of one faculty in phase 3 and does not restore it.
